title: A checkbox default is not a seatbelt
myth: Setting a checkbox default to Checked keeps it checked.

beats.say: Dex sets the Agreed checkbox default to Checked. Now it's always checked!
Ada sips. A default is applied once, when the record is created.
After that, Penny unticks it in one click.
A must-be-checked rule belongs in a validation rule.
A default is a starting state, not a seatbelt.

facts.claim: A checkbox default value is applied once, when the record is created.
facts.evidence: that choice is applied once, when the record is created

facts.claim: A default is a starting state and not a constraint.
facts.evidence: a default is a starting state and not a constraint

facts.claim: A must-be-checked rule belongs in a validation rule, not in the default value.
facts.evidence: belongs in a validation rule, not in the default value
